name: freezing-glare
flavor_text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
effect_text_extend:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy.  It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.
effect_text_simple: Has a chance to freeze the target.
